questions.question_text: What does the “S” in HTTPS stand for, and why is it important when browsing the internet?

options.text: Speed; it makes websites load faster for better streaming
Secure; it encrypts your data to protect it from hackers
Simple; it simplifies the website design for easier use
Social; it connects you to social media platforms safely

correct_answer.text: Secure; it encrypts your data to protect it from hackers

questions.question_text: What is a major risk of using public Wi-Fi, and how can you stay safe?

options.text: It’s too slow for gaming; use a wired connection instead
It’s often unsecured, allowing hackers to spy; use a VPN for protection
It costs money to connect; avoid it by using mobile data always
It limits app downloads; only download apps at home

correct_answer.text: It’s often unsecured, allowing hackers to spy; use a VPN for protection

questions.question_text: When downloading apps, what is a key safety tip to follow to avoid malware or scams?

options.text: Download from random websites for exclusive free versions
Only use official stores like Google Play or Apple App Store and check reviews
Install apps that ask for access to all your data for full features
Always download “cracked” versions to save money on paid apps

correct_answer.text: Only use official stores like Google Play or Apple App Store and check reviews

questions.question_text: How can you identify clickbait or a suspicious link before clicking on it?

options.text: It promises realistic rewards and comes from a trusted friend
It uses over-the-top headlines like “SHOCKING!” and has a weird URL
It’s posted by a verified account with a blue checkmark
It leads to a well-known website with an HTTPS lock icon

correct_answer.text: It uses over-the-top headlines like “SHOCKING!” and has a weird URL

questions.question_text: What should you do if you receive a message with a link saying, “Win Free Robux Now!” from an unknown sender?

options.text: Click it immediately to claim the reward before it’s gone
Ignore or delete it, as it’s likely clickbait or a scam, and don’t click the link
Share it with friends to see if they think it’s real
Enter your gaming login to verify the offer is legit

correct_answer.text: Ignore or delete it, as it’s likely clickbait or a scam, and don’t click the link
